gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws geometric, hollow-feeling letters in a single ribbon of line, sitting under Hachi Maru Pop's loose, stretched-out handwriting. Give the body a modest size.
gen-gf-hanalei-fill-fs-paquito: Paquito keeps its small letters nearly as tall as its capitals. Under Hanalei Fill's stencil-cut, pressure-free strokes, that gives the pair a bold, confident punch.
gen-gf-handlee-archivo: Handlee writes in tightly gathered, hand-drawn letters, while Archivo stands below with a commanding x-height and curves that open outward. Save Handlee for big, short lines.
gen-gf-handlee-fs-asap: Tightly gathered, hand-drawn letters give Handlee a casual grace, and Asap lines up underneath with open arcs and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. One feels jotted, the other feels printed.
gen-gf-handlee-fs-epilogue: Curvy and a little unclamped, Epilogue reads as a friendly, contemporary voice with tall lowercase and stubby ascender tips. Epilogue's wire-thin monoline strokes would keep a longer page moving easily beneath Handlee's handwriting.
gen-gf-handlee-fs-fira-sans: Handwritten warmth meets crisp structure, with Handlee's gathered, hand-drawn letters above Fira Sans, whose large x-height and wide-open s curves never thin out. They feel like a note pinned over a printout.
gen-gf-handlee-fs-karma: Trustworthy and classic, Karma finishes its terminals well clear of the stem and keeps lowercase close to capital height. And Handlee brings the casual, hand-drawn graceful side, leaving Karma to carry the steadier work.
gen-gf-handlee-fs-merriweather-sans: Sturdy meets handwritten here, with Handlee's gathered, hand-drawn letters above Merriweather Sans, whose tall lowercase makes words look large and solid. That difference in character is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-handlee-fs-public-sans: Handlee's hand-drawn letters, tightly gathered and gently swelling on the curves, set the tone before anything else. Public Sans then adds a hefty, trustworthy lowercase with broad open counters, and that weight is the strongest quality here.
gen-gf-handlee-fs-ranade: Handlee's counters spill out into the space around its tightly gathered, hand-drawn letters, giving the heading a casual grace. Ranade's widely spaced, slightly stretchy strokes make the strongest quality an organic looseness.
